entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The user equipment that performs multicast MRB release procedures.

entities.name: Multicast MRB Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for releasing multicast MRB resources including PDCP entities and notifying upper layers.

entities.name: MRB Identity
entities.description: Identifier for multicast radio bearers that are to be released.

entities.name: MRB To Release List
entities.description: List containing MRB identities that are to be released.

entities.name: PDCP Entity
entities.description: Packet Data Convergence Protocol entity associated with the multicast MRB.

entities.name: Temporary Mobile Group Identity
entities.description: Identifier for the multicast service associated with the released MRB.

entities.name: Full Configuration Condition
entities.description: Condition where MRB release occurs as result of full configuration according to clause 5.3.5.11.

entities.name: Current UE Configuration Condition
entities.description: Condition where MRB identity is part of current UE configuration.

relations.description: UE performs multicast MRB release procedure
Procedure uses MRB To Release List to determine which MRBs to release
Procedure requires MRB identity to be part of current UE configuration
Procedure can be triggered by full configuration condition
Procedure results in release of PDCP entity
Procedure results in release of MRB identity
Procedure indicates release of multicast MRB and TMGI to upper layers
